name: Target Attributes Filter
description: Filter to add target attribute to hyperlinks.
project_description: Override the hyperlink target attribute using text formats. Provides a single text-format filter plugin (filter_target_attributes) that walks anchor tags in the rendered HTML with the DOM parser and sets each link's target attribute. An admin chooses the target value (_blank, _self, _parent, _top), whether it applies to all links or only internal or only external links (matched by comparing the link host against the request host, with a leading www. stripped), and whether an existing target attribute is replaced. Configured per text format under Filter settings; no routes, permissions, services, or Drush commands of its own.
